name: Atlantean Secrets book series
description:
I collected these books over a period of years while attending some courses with Clairvision school. I fell in love with the characters and was inspired to pursue my meditation and inner awareness journey with optimism for our future. ❤️
I haven't read them in a while and I don't know if people read books anymore 😅 but if you like the idea of using technology and spirituality for good, these books take you into a visionary world of spirit and technology combined.

pictured: A stack of eight books by Samuel Sagan, including the four-volume Atlantean Secrets series, Bleeding Sun, Sleeper Awaken!, Planetary Forces, Regression, and Entities.
